detect.title: Install and import
detect.subtitle: What is installed, what Pelagos needs, step by step plans

detect.title: Detected on this node
detect.keys: TSIG keys ddi-read and ddi-admin present

mode.importBody: Keep the running BIND and Kea. Pelagos reads them, adds one include line, the control sockets, the statistics channel and its TSIG keys. Nothing else is rewritten.
mode.installBody: Install BIND and Kea packages that are missing, with minimal configurations, control sockets and the Pelagos include files.

help.import: Engines found on this node that Pelagos will manage.
help.install: Engines to install on this node.

reason.inactive: Not running and not enabled: skipped by default

source.distroBody: apt or dnf from the distribution repositories. Versions follow the distribution.
source.iscBody: Current BIND and Kea from the ISC Cloudsmith repositories, with all the Kea hooks.

help.import: The plan lists what was read and what will be added. Each step is backed up, validated and rolled back if it fails.
help.install: The plan lists the packages and files. Applying it runs a job on this node; progress shows below.

errors.notSelectable: One of the chosen engines is not available in this mode
errors.d2NeedsKea: DHCP-DDNS needs Kea DHCPv4 or DHCPv6
errors.source: Choose where the packages come from

security.cleanBody: The configuration has nothing to harden.
security.planHelp: Selected findings are fixed one after the other, never at once: backup, write, validation, reload, check, and rollback if a step fails.

dualKey.add: Add the new hmac-sha256 key to the BIND update-policy, next to the old one
dualKey.switch: Switch kea-dhcp-ddns to the new key on every node
dualKey.remove: Remove the old key from BIND and Kea

security.manualHelp: Pelagos cannot fix this one automatically: apply the manual action, then audit again.

exception.title: Keep this finding as it is
exception.reasonHelp: Kept in cluster.toml with your name and the date; the finding stops raising alerts until the exception is removed.
exception.reasonRequired: Say why this finding is left as it is
exception.listHelp: Admin's choices: removing an exception lists the finding again.

drift.adopt: Adopt: keep the node as it is

guard.title: HA listener guard
guard.help: The nftables guard that lets only the HA peers and backups reach the Kea HA listeners of this node. Changing the addresses builds a plan: the guard is put back as it was if the peers' packets stop getting through.
guard.none: No Kea HA listener off loopback on this node.
guard.nftMissing: nft is not installed on this node: the guard cannot be managed.
guard.peers: Allowed addresses (one per line: HA peers, backups, prefixes)
guard.legacyHelp: A guard was set up outside Pelagos ({{source}}). Adopting it loads the same addresses into Pelagos's guard first, then retires the old one: the listener stays guarded throughout.
